title: US solvency-flag back-test (pre-registered, survivorship-free, 2015/2017/2019 snapshots): negative equity (ex-buyback) and >=2 solvency flags = GRADED RED (lift ~2.3x, <10% of winners lost); interest cover <1.5x, short-term funding gap, payouts>FCF = questions; none qualifies as hard
body: 4,843 candidate CIKs from dei:EntityPublicFloat frames -> 4,821 firm-snapshots (2,271 firms; ex financials/REITs/utilities; float $300M-$20B from the latest 10-K filed <= T; as-first-reported companyfacts). 5-year O_fail = 8-K 1.03 bankruptcy (213) or delisting for cause (19, revised after audit) or month-end price <= 0.2x (233): 460 = 9.5% base. Pooled lift [CIK bootstrap]: S1 2.31 [1.63,3.11], winners lost 3.7%; S2 1.98 [1.79,2.17], 27%; S3 1.55 [1.04,2.16], 5.4%; S4 1.06 [0.84,1.31], 13.8%; S5 2.37 [1.90,2.86], 8.0%. Verdict: S1 and S5 GRADED RED; S2/S3/S4 QUESTIONS; nothing HARD (best EDGAR-only lift 3.28). Recall is low (S5 16%): most failures (2015-16 energy, COVID) had positive equity a year before. Flagged-firm median size-matched 5y excess is ~+0.07 (lottery shape: big recoveries among survivors) -> flags are sizing/avoid rules, not shorts. Survivorship audit: 97% of bankrupt firms have no Yahoo history; 45% of rows have no price - O_fail understated there; EDGAR events fate-independent. Deviation: as-registered delisting rule (3.01+Form 25/15) was dominated by voluntary exchange transfers; text-classified version used; as-registered results give the same verdicts. Indian re-test needed (IBC/IBBI + delisted universe; buybacks rare so exemption seldom applies; NBFC ALM test separately).

verdicts.S4: QUESTION (lift 1.06 < 2; lift CI touches 1; excludes 14% of >3x winners)

data.unlocks: graded solvency flags (S1, S5) in disqualifiers v2; Pi detector; Indian re-test on dead-company universe

title: US solvency back-test 2015/17/19: S1 negative equity (ex buyback-driven with FCF>0) -> GRADED RED
body: Negative stockholders' equity unless FCF>0 and treasury stock + 3y dividends+buybacks >= |equity|. Pooled lift 2.31 [1.63, 3.11] for 5-year failure (bankruptcy / delisting for cause / price <= 0.2x); 21.5% of flagged firms failed vs 9.3% base; excludes 3.7% (10/273) of eventual >3x winners (Caesars-2015, Dell-2019, Tenet-2019, Exelixis-2015, Domino's-2015). Recall only 7.7%. Exempted buyback firms failed 4.3% (below base) - the exemption works; raw negative equity is weaker (lift 1.63). EDGAR-only failures lift 3.12; per-snapshot 1.65/2.86/2.66 (2015 CI touches 1: energy failures had positive equity). Not hard (< 4x). Universe: 4,821 US non-financial firm-snapshots (float $300M-$20B, 10-K filed <= T), dead firms included. Research, not advice.

title: US solvency back-test 2015/17/19: S2 interest cover (EBIT/interest) < 1.5x -> QUESTION
body: Pooled lift 1.98 [1.79, 2.17] - just under the 2x bar - and it would have excluded 27% (74/273) of eventual >3x winners. It mostly re-labels operating losses: S0 (EBIT<0) alone gives lift 1.92 and excludes 24% of winners; profitable firms with cover <1.5 (exploratory) lift 1.80. Use as a deep-dive question (cover at mid-cycle margins, maturity wall), not a flag. Universe: 4,821 US non-financial firm-snapshots (float $300M-$20B, 10-K filed <= T), dead firms included. Research, not advice.

title: US solvency back-test 2015/17/19: S3 short-term debt > cash + 0.5xCFO (funding gap) -> QUESTION
body: Pooled lift 1.55 [1.04, 2.16], unstable across snapshots (1.58/2.23/1.12); excludes 5.4% of winners. Floor-plan-financed dealers and working-capital borrowers fire without distress. Keep as a question: what refinances the near-term debt? Universe: 4,821 US non-financial firm-snapshots (float $300M-$20B, 10-K filed <= T), dead firms included. Research, not advice.

title: US solvency back-test 2015/17/19: S4 dividends+buybacks > FCF while total debt rose -> QUESTION (no signal)
body: Pooled lift 1.06 [0.84, 1.31] - no information about 5-year failure - and excludes 13.8% of >3x winners. Drop as a solvency flag; keep as a capital-allocation question. Universe: 4,821 US non-financial firm-snapshots (float $300M-$20B, 10-K filed <= T), dead firms included. Research, not advice.

data.verdict: QUESTION (lift 1.06 < 2; lift CI touches 1; excludes 14% of >3x winners)

title: US solvency back-test 2015/17/19: S5 two or more of S1-S4 -> GRADED RED
body: Pooled lift 2.37 [1.90, 2.86]; 22.5% of flagged firms failed vs 9.5% base; recall 16%; excludes 8.0% (22/276) of >3x winners (11% in 2017 - near the limit; e.g. FTAI, Plug, Natera, Fair Isaac, IDEXX). EDGAR-only failures lift 3.28 [2.59, 4.08]; stable per snapshot 2.11/2.77/2.39. Not hard (< 4x). Caught Sears, Frontier, GNC, Dean Foods, Alpha Natural, Arch, Bristow, Diebold, Endo, Weatherford. Universe: 4,821 US non-financial firm-snapshots (float $300M-$20B, 10-K filed <= T), dead firms included. Research, not advice.
